Frequently Asked Questions

# Frequently Asked Questions

How do I place an order?

When you find an item you love, please select the size (if applicable) and quantity you prefer and click “add to cart”. After adding all of your favorite items to your cart, you can complete your purchase by clicking the shopping cart icon in the top right corner. Once you have reviewed your cart and confirmed all information is correct, you will click “proceed to checkout”. You will fill out all billing, shipping, and payment information, and then click “Pay securely with credit card”. Once processed, you will receive an order confirmation.

What form of payment does Simply Southern accept?

We accept most credit cards and debit cards. We do not accept cash or checks for online purchases.

Can I modify an order once placed?

To ship orders as quickly as possible, we ask that you review your cart closely before completing your purchase. We cannot guarantee every modification but will do our best to accommodate any changes if possible. If you need to make a change to your order, please contact customer service at claims@simplysouthern.com.

How can I send someone an order as a gift?

Simply Southern products make great gifts! When filling out the billing and shipping information during checkout, be sure to fill out the shipping address as the address for the lucky receiver. Under the zip code field, there will be a field that says “If your order is a gift, enter your gift message here. (optional)”. We will include your personalized message within the box.

Does Simply Southern take orders over the phone?

We do not currently take orders by phone at this time. You can email us about placing an order at claims@simplysouthern.com.

My order was cancelled, what happened?

Orders may be cancelled for a variety of reasons including lack of inventory or system error. Simply Southern reserves the right to cancel any order due to unauthorized, altered, or ineligible use of promotional codes or merchandise. For help, please contact customer service at claims@simplysouthern.com.

When will my order be shipped?

Our standard processing time is 5 to 7 business days. Our shipping time will change due to holidays or during our busy seasons in January and July.

How do I return or exchange my order?

To return or exchange your item(s), please contact claims@simplysouthern.com. We will try to accommodate your request, but cannot guarantee we can honor every return or exchange request depending on the reason for the request and the inventory available.

When I put something in my cart and complete my purchase, does it guarantee I will get the merchandise?

We try to accommodate all orders. Inventory does change often, so in the instance where we are unable to fulfill an item within an order, we will reach out to you and issue a refund or exchange. But don’t lose hope! You may always contact customer service at retail@simplysouthern.com to locate an item at one of our stores.

results.title: REVIEW: Freschetta Simply… Inspired Southern BBQ Recipe Chicken Pizza
results.author: Nichol
results.text:
REVIEW: Freschetta Simply… Inspired Southern BBQ Recipe Chicken Pizza

Often it’s the little things that provide the greatest inspiration: the first autumn leaves swirling in the breeze, the laughter of children, the ethereal glow of crashing waves in the full moonlight, etc. And now, Freschetta hopes you’ll add BBQ chicken pizza to that list, along with the seven other new varieties not found at my local Target as of last week. That’s right folks â€“ branch-clinging kitten poster levels of inspiration can be yours, instantly, for the low, low price of five dollars.

With it you’ll also get inordinate levels of pretension, free of charge. In my head, I’m pronouncing Target as Tar-zjay. That’s how pretentious I’ve become just a few hours after my discovery of the Simply… Inspired Pizzas, which supposedly feature larger and more prevalent toppings, a crispier crust and come in a more form-fitting box. This makes me instantly better than you by association. I feel like scoffing at the Red Baron and flippantly ignoring Wolfgang Puck as he calls to me from down the way. Digiorno? California Pizza Kitchen? Tombstone? Amateurs, the lot of them.

If I had to peg one element that truly elevates this pizza above those with cookies, dips, budget-rate price tags, and garlic crusts, I’d say… it’s the ellipses in the title. Hands down. As far as I can tell, nobody else in frozen food section has yet taken advantage of the grandeur and enticement of this rare bit of punctuation. In a world of keyboard bashing neurotics, the ellipses falls dangerously close to becoming the snootier, desperately more boring cousin of the interrobang. It hangs there mid-sentence as if to say, “Oh, sorry there. Didn’t mean to start off too overwhelmingly fast (for idiots like yourself). Let’s take a pause, shall we. And you know what? It might be time to skim over the really dull, academic bits. It’s the least I can do, really, without adding footnotes and visual aids.”

Inspired? Really? By all the other previously existing BBQ chicken pizzas you mean? What’s that? Oh, of course: you’re different. This apparently isn’t the California-born taste revolution you’ve naively fallen for. Oh no. This one’s a unique blend of “classic flavors of the south”, meaning the cilantro is almost non-existent and the “sweet and tangy” sauce pretty much tastes like KC Masterpiece.

Peeling open the package initially reveals large white meat chicken chunks and thick cut onions, true to the pompous package promises. This gives me tragically high hopes, which immediately began to droop and melt away along with the pizza as soon as I toss it in the oven.

I sit on my kitchen floor in denial for the first few minutes, staring vacantly as the crust buckles and cheese drips into the abyss.

Simply Sleep, manufactured by Simply Sleep Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, claims to improve sleep quality, reduce the time to fall asleep, and eliminate grogginess upon waking. However, these claims lack robust scientific backing. The transparency of ingredient dosages and sourcing raises red flags. While natural sleep aids can be effective, Simply Sleep fails to disclose whether its ingredients are present in effective amounts. The marketing also heavily relies on vague promises rather than credible research. These issues significantly undermine the product’s reliability.

## Company Behind Simply Sleep

Simply Sleep Pharmaceuticals Private Limited has a history of disappointing customers with ineffective products and questionable practices. Customer complaints often cite recurring issues with side effects, lack of effectiveness, and unresponsive customer service. The company has a poor rating on BBB, reflecting its failure to meet customer expectations. Given its track record, Simply Sleep is likely another subpar product from this manufacturer.

Simply Sleep’s ingredient list is questionable at best, and transparency is a major concern.
